title: Hugonnet et al. 2021, Nature (accelerated global glacier mass loss, 2000–2019)
target: Hugonnet et al. 2021, Nature (accelerated global glacier mass loss, 2000–2019)
summary: The 95% interval on the mass-loss acceleration (48 ± 16 Gt/yr per decade) was formed by doubling a 1σ interval from a regression with ~2 degrees of freedom; the correct t-based 95% half-width is ~1.64× larger (about ±26). The acceleration remains significant at the corrected level; the author notes conservative assumptions elsewhere (temporal decorrelation, density conversion) likely offset the narrower interval.

title: NASA MERRA-2 corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR) over Australia
target: NASA MERRA-2 corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR) over Australia
summary: About a 20% dry step from 2016 in PRECTOTCORR over Australia, inherited from the CPC Unified gauge analysis (CPCU) that MERRA-2 uses to correct land precipitation. CPCU's own gauge-count field shows Australia lost about 95% of its gauges in two steps (2007–08 and 2015–16, e.g. E Australia ~590 → 90). GPCP and GPCC do not show the step, and a gauge-independent reanalysis (NCEP R1) confirms it sits in CPCU.
